Changes.note: The YouTube link you save is written to the session and to the audit log. The enrolled talebe and the course team see it on the watch page from the session's scheduled start, and keep seeing it until the session has a recording open to talebe or 24 hours have passed since its scheduled end. Removing the link deletes it at once and you can add a new one; but once the session's scheduled end has passed, this page no longer lets you change or remove it.
